structure.opis: obiekt techniczny lub duza konstrukcja, nie budynek

rozmiar.wh: about {w} m wide and {h} m tall
rozmiar.lh: about {w} m long and {h} m tall
rozmiar.cm: about {w} cm wide and {h} cm tall
rozmiar.wd: about {w} m wide and {d} m deep
rozmiar.kafel: one ground tile of {w} by {w} m

koncowki.front_plaski: Pixel art game sprite, fixed orthographic RPG 3/4 camera, front facade facing the viewer, flat rectangular roof visible from above, isolated on solid magenta #FF00FF background.
koncowki.front: Pixel art game sprite, fixed orthographic RPG 3/4 camera, the front facing the viewer and the top seen slightly from above, isolated on solid magenta #FF00FF background.
koncowki.bok_prawo: Pixel art game sprite, fixed orthographic RPG 3/4 camera, the side facing the viewer and the top seen slightly from above, facing right, isolated on solid magenta #FF00FF background.
koncowki.bok_lewo: Pixel art game sprite, fixed orthographic RPG 3/4 camera, the side facing the viewer and the top seen slightly from above, facing left, isolated on solid magenta #FF00FF background.
koncowki.przod: Pixel art game sprite, fixed orthographic RPG 3/4 camera, the front facing the viewer and the top seen slightly from above, facing the viewer, isolated on solid magenta #FF00FF background.
koncowki.tyl: Pixel art game sprite, fixed orthographic RPG 3/4 camera, the back facing the viewer and the top seen slightly from above, facing away from the viewer, isolated on solid magenta #FF00FF background.
koncowki.kafel: Pixel art game texture, fixed orthographic RPG 3/4 camera, flat ground seen from above, seamless square tile filling the whole image.
koncowki.nakladka: Pixel art game sprite, fixed orthographic RPG 3/4 camera, lying flat on the ground seen from above, isolated on solid magenta #FF00FF background.

dopisek_okragle: round shapes drawn straight from the front with their tops visible as flattened ellipses
dopisek_okragle_gdzie: przed ', isolated on' w koncowkach front_plaski i front, tylko gdy obiekt ma okragle czesci
drzwi_wejsciowe: and the standard entrance door in the middle of the front facade
and the standard entrance door on the left side of the front facade
and the standard entrance door on the right side of the front facade

styl_uzdatniony.opis: wariant K: zamiana poczatku koncowki + materialy w opisie

decorative object: structure albo outdoor prop - recznie wg obiektu

bez_podloza: obiekt bez podloza pod spodem i dookola (perony, plyty, chodniki, trawniki, tory, woda terenu: jezioro/rzeka/morze/kanal) - podloze i woda to assety dioramy; woda bedaca czescia obiektu (fontanna, basen) zostaje
